impact: .before-pane .pane-label uses `left: calc(1.25rem + 40px + 0.6rem)` to sit to the right of the close button. That assumes a 40px close button, but the actual button ("← New file" chevron + label) is wider (~90px), so the "BEFORE" pill gets clipped — only "RE" is visible. Verified live at localhost:5180 with the Roboto sample. Fix: reserve the label width dynamically (flex layout on the pane top-bar, or `left: 8rem`-ish), or shorten the button to icon-only.
resolution: Committed in 8a2f505. Bumped .before-pane .pane-label offset from `calc(1.25rem + 40px + 0.6rem)` to `calc(1.25rem + 100px + 0.6rem)`. The 40px assumed a "×" close button; the actual "← New file" button measures ~92px. Verified live at localhost:5180 — the "BEFORE" pill now sits cleanly to the right of the button.
title: "BEFORE" pane label clipped behind wider "New file" button
